description: This file contains the CommandResolver enum which encapsulates command resolution logic for the OpenClaw project on macOS. It includes methods for identifying entry points, resolving runtime configurations, managing project paths, locating executables, and handling SSH remote command execution.

methods.name: gatewayEntrypoint
methods.description: Determines the entry point path for the JavaScript or TypeScript project by checking for specific files within the given root directory.

methods.name: runtimeResolution
methods.description: Resolves the runtime configuration, returning either a successful runtime resolution or an error.

methods.name: makeRuntimeCommand
methods.description: Constructs the command array to execute the runtime with the specified entrypoint, subcommand, and extra arguments.

methods.name: runtimeErrorCommand
methods.description: Generates a command array that outputs a runtime resolution error message.

methods.name: errorCommand
methods.description: Creates a shell script command that logs an error message and exits.

methods.name: projectRoot
methods.description: Determines the current project root directory, based on stored defaults or fallback paths.

methods.name: setProjectRoot
methods.description: Stores the specified path as the project root in user defaults.

methods.name: projectRootPath
methods.description: Returns the string path of the current project root.

methods.name: preferredPaths
methods.description: Computes an ordered list of preferred search paths for executables, incorporating environment variables, user directories, and project-specific paths.

methods.name: findExecutable
methods.description: Searches for an executable file with the given name within the specified search paths.

methods.name: openclawExecutable
methods.description: Finds the 'openclaw' executable within the search paths.

methods.name: projectOpenClawExecutable
methods.description: Locates the project-specific 'openclaw' executable, especially in development mode.

methods.name: nodeCliPath
methods.description: Retrieves the path to the Node.js CLI scripts if available.

methods.name: hasAnyOpenClawInvoker
methods.description: Checks if any openclaw invocation method (local executable or node environment) is available.

methods.name: openclawNodeCommand
methods.description: Builds the command array to invoke openclaw via Node.js or SSH, considering local and remote execution contexts.

methods.name: openclawCommand
methods.description: Public interface for obtaining the command array to invoke openclaw, aliasing openclawNodeCommand.

methods.name: connectionSettings
methods.description: Loads and returns SSH remote connection configuration from defaults and config files.

methods.name: connectionModeIsRemote
methods.description: Checks whether the current connection mode is remote SSH.

methods.name: parseSSHTarget
methods.description: Parses SSH target string into user, host, and port components.

methods.name: sshTargetValidationMessage
methods.description: Provides validation error messages for SSH target strings.

methods.name: sshArguments
methods.description: Constructs the argument array for SSH commands based on target and options.

methods.name: makeSSHTarget
methods.description: Builds a structured SSH target object from optional user, host, and port inputs.
